stage0073_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$つばさ$$
「So $$あしゅら$$'s made up his mind too...」

stage0073_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$つばさ$$
「All that's left is for me to finish
　that man off, and the whole affair
　over Bardos Island ends.」

stage0073_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Wait right there...
　I've tracked down where you are.」

stage0073_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Kenzo...
　This time, I'll finish you off completely.」

stage0073_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So it's finally the showdown
　with $$あしゅら$$...」

stage0073_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$隼人$$
「Even he seems to have made up his mind.
　This time, he won't run or hide.」

stage0073_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$弁慶$$
「Plus, the battlefield is the Science Fortress.
　No traps to worry about there.」

stage0073_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'm just gonna go cool my head off.」

stage0073_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$キタン$$
「Is he getting nervous before the big fight?」

stage0073_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「That feeling... seems a bit different.」

stage0073_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ボス$$
「$$甲児$$'s just lonely.
　To him, $$あしゅら$$ is the whole history
　of his fight with Mazinger.」

stage0073_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「I see...
　I can't say I don't understand that feeling...」

stage0073_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Heh... It's an old story.」

stage0073_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That $$甲児$$, getting sentimental,
　not like him at all.」

stage0073_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$シモン$$
「What'll we do, $$竜馬$$?
　Should we go talk to him?」

stage0073_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That's not a job for me.」

stage0073_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$甲児$$
（You're my grandpa's killer,
　the one who dragged me into
　a hellish fight...）

stage0073_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$甲児$$
（But wasn't that because
　Dr. Hell had deceived you...?）

stage0073_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$甲児$$
（When we joined forces to beat Dr. Hell,
　there was something like a bond between us.
　And yet...）

stage0073_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$さやか$$...
　Tomorrow's the big battle. What are
　you doing out at a time like this?」

stage0073_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$さやか$$
「I came to look at the stars.
　With you, $$甲児$$.」

stage0073_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$甲児$$
「Stars...? You mean that star of ill omen
　$$グーラ$$ was talking about?」

stage0073_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$甲児$$
「Th- that's a little too close, isn't it...」

stage0073_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$さやか$$
「It's fine.
　No one's watching, after all.」

stage0073_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$n
「S- sorry...!
　I didn't mean to peep or get in
　the way...!」

stage0073_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$カレン$$
「Same as $$さやか$$, I got curious
　about $$甲児$$.」

stage0073_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$さやか$$
「Does that mean $$カレン$$'s also...
　about $$甲児$$...?」

stage0073_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$宗介$$
「To be precise, as a comrade-in-arms.」

stage0073_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$n
「Don't go deciding this is your last
　battle on your own, $$甲児$$.」

stage0073_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Even if we beat $$あしゅら$$,
　our fight's still not over.」

stage0073_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So, $$甲児$$... let's do our best.」

stage0073_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$甲児$$
「...Never thought I'd be the one
　getting encouraged by $$シンジ$$.」

stage0073_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「S- sorry!
　That was out of line...」

stage0073_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$甲児$$
「You've grown too, through all this fighting.」

stage0073_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$甲児$$
「If I'd never gotten into Mazinger,
　I'd probably still be the school's
　shadow boss...」

stage0073_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$n
「But $$あしゅら男爵$$ is our enemy.」

stage0073_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$甲児$$
「I know.
　That's why I'll settle this myself.」

stage0073_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$n
「Good, that works out.
　He wants that too.」

stage0073_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$甲児$$
「Then I'll do it.
　Like you all said, my fight's not
　over yet.」

stage0073_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$アルト$$
「See ya, $$甲児$$.
　We're turning in for the night.」

stage0073_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$カレン$$
「You do your best too, $$さやか$$.」

stage0073_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$甲児$$
「What'll you do, $$さやか$$?
　I'm... gonna stay here a bit longer...」

stage0073_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$甲児$$
「Then come over here.
　September's almost over, so the
　nights are getting cold.」

stage0073_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$甲児$$
（Once dawn breaks, it's the final
　battle... $$あしゅら$$... I'll settle
　this between us once and for all.）

stage0073_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
Kenzo
「Judging by your state,
　it seems $$暗黒寺$$ failed, doesn't it...」

stage0073_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$つばさ$$
「What are you even talking about...!」

stage0073_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
Kenzo
「$$つばさ$$...
　You've come to kill me, haven't you?」

stage0073_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$つばさ$$
「That's right.
　But I won't just go on living easy
　after killing $$甲児$$ and $$シロー$$'s father.」

stage0073_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$つばさ$$
「With this photon bomb, I'll send us both,
　you and me, straight to hell!
　This ends the whole affair over Bardos Island!」

stage0073_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Begging for your life, at a time
　like this! How pathetic!」

stage0073_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Shut up!
　What could you possibly say now!」

stage0073_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
Kenzo
「Then at least look at me first...
　Yes... at this pitiful form of mine...!」

stage0073_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$つばさ$$
「The end result of being parasitized
　by Kedora...」

stage0073_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
Kenzo
「That's right.
　To regain my sense of self, I had to
　abandon the body Kedora had taken.」

stage0073_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$つばさ$$
「That's your own fault, isn't it!」

stage0073_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
Kenzo
「It's true, Mycenae's secrets captivated me.
　Parasitized by Kedora during my research,
　I tried to kill my father Juzo, and you.」

stage0073_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
Kenzo
「But when I touched $$ゼウス$$'s right arm,
　which you all tried to carry off Bardos
　Island, its light let me regain myself.」

stage0073_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$つばさ$$
「And so you cast aside your body
　to escape Kedora's curse, is that it?」

stage0073_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
Kenzo
「That's right.
　And I've survived like this in order
　to keep watch over Dr. Hell.」

stage0073_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$つばさ$$
「So that's why you used Gamia
　to secretly help me and $$甲児$$!」

stage0073_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Don't give me that!
　You think that makes it forgivable,
　after everything, now?!」

stage0073_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
Kenzo
「...I understand that.
　That's why, now that Dr. Hell has fallen,
　I intended to simply rot away like this.」

stage0073_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
Kenzo
「But if he... if $$あしゅら男爵$$ is alive,
　that changes things.」

stage0073_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$つばさ$$
「What could that walking corpse possibly
　still mean!?」

stage0073_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
Kenzo
「Looking back, the fight over Bardos Island
　was nothing but deceit, impersonation,
　secrets, and betrayal after betrayal...」

stage0073_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
Kenzo
「And the culmination of it all is him...
　$$あしゅら男爵$$.」

stage0073_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
Kenzo
「Now that the star of ill omen fills
　the heavens, he...」

stage0073_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hahahahaha!
　Ha, hahahahaha!
　Hahaha, buhahahaha!」

stage0073_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「He actually did it...!
　He actually did it, that $$あしゅら$$!」

stage0073_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Nice, nice!
　The wrathful gods descend!
　Earth's in for total chaos now!」

stage0073_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So, what'll you do, Earthlings?
　Your foe's a god, no ordinary means
　could ever beat that!」

stage0073_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Let's see it, then.
　That famous comeback of yours...!
　That is, if you can even pull it off!」

stage0073_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Isn't making a racket like this
　a bit of a nuisance here?」

stage0073_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「My apologies...
　Just having a little celebratory drink.」

stage0073_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Perfect timing.
　Care to join me for a drink?
　My treat, of course.」

stage0073_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「...Fine.
　I was a little bored anyway.」

stage0073_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Boredom, decadence, and idleness,
　all forgiven... This city's practically
　heaven, if you ask me.」

stage0073_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「No past, no future...
　this city might just be a prison...」

stage0073_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Doesn't seem to be to your liking.」

stage0073_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Just the name, maybe.
　Everything else about you is perfect.」

stage0073_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But today, let's forget all the boring
　stuff. Let's really enjoy ourselves,
　$$エンジェル$$.」

stage0073_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「If we can forget, then let's not stop
　at today, let's hope for forever.」

stage0073_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「A toast, to this eternal today.」

stage0073_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I'm terribly sorry.
　Today I'm a bit occupied, so
　I'm unable to attend to you.」

stage0073_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The celebration for the ace pilot
　will also have to wait for another time.」

stage0073_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The D-Trader is open, though,
　so please feel free to use it.」
